position_outside: UN/LOCODE places Waterford at (52.25, -7.1), in the city south of the Suir, about 4 km west of Belview, the only berths these limits cover. A ship cannot be there.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals from OpenStreetMap, grown by 500 m, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it (the sea within its coastline, rivers, docks and basins), with the terminals kept whole
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Waterford. These are the hull of Belview, grown by 500 m, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it, with the terminals kept whole and a 30 m margin where they meet the water. A scan of OpenStreetMap finds no homes, residential land, schools, hospitals, places of worship or named places inside.

properties.name: Belview Port
properties.note: Tagged industrial=port and operator=Port of Waterford. The Port of Waterford lists three berths here: the Belview Container Terminal (containers and project cargo), the Belview Bulk Terminal (bulk and general cargo) and the Suir Shipping quay (bulk).
